summary: Pinnacle Financial Partners filed an 8-K reporting entry into an underwriting agreement to sell $750 million aggregate principal amount of 5.596% Fixed Rate / Floating Rate Senior Notes due 2032. The offering was made under an existing shelf registration statement. Underwriters include Morgan Stanley, RBC Capital Markets, and Goldman Sachs. Closing is expected May 19, 2026, subject to customary conditions. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
